question: My payment failed but money was deducted.
answer: Don't worry! If the charging session did not start, the deducted amount is automatically refunded to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

question: The charging gun is stuck and won't unlock.
answer: First, ensure charging has stopped in the app. Then, press the 'Unlock' button on your car key fob 3 times. If that fails, most cars have an emergency manual release lever inside the boot/trunk.

question: Why is my car charging slowly?
answer: Charging speed depends on your car's BMS. If your battery is over 80% (trickle charging) or the battery temperature is too high/low, the car reduces intake speed to protect the cells.

question: How do I start charging?
answer: 1. Plug the connector into your car. 2. Scan the QR code on the machine using the VoltPath app. 3. Confirm payment method and swipe 'Start Charging'.

question: How do I stop the charging session?
answer: Open the active session screen in the app and slide/tap 'Stop Charging'. Wait for the connector to unlock (listen for a click sound) before unplugging.

question: How much does charging cost?
answer: Rates vary by station operator (CPO), usually between ₹15 to ₹25 per kWh. You can see the exact rate per unit on the station details card before you plug in.

question: Is it safe to charge in the rain?
answer: Yes, completely safe. EV connectors and charging ports are waterproof (IP67 rated). Just ensure water doesn't pool directly inside the open connector pins.

question: Is this charger compatible with my car?
answer: VoltPath supports all major standards. Most Indian cars (Nexon, ZS EV) use CCS2 for DC fast charging. Two-wheelers mostly use standard 15A sockets or proprietary plugs.

question: Why do I need a minimum wallet balance?
answer: A minimum balance (usually ₹200-₹500) ensures the session doesn't cut off abruptly if the cost exceeds your initial estimate. Unused balance remains safe in your wallet.

question: Where can I see my past charging sessions?
answer: Go to the 'Profile' tab and select 'Charging History'. You can view details like energy consumed, cost, and download invoices there.

question: Should I charge to 100% every time?
answer: For daily use, it's recommended to stop at 80-90% to prolong battery life. Charge to 100% mainly for long highway trips.

question: When should I use the Emergency Stop button?
answer: Only use the physical Red Emergency Button on the charger if you see smoke, sparks, or fire. Using it for normal stops can lock the gun and require a technician to reset.

question: Can I reserve a charging slot in advance?
answer: Currently, VoltPath works on a first-come-first-serve basis. However, you can check the 'Real-Time Availability' status on the map to see if a spot is free before driving there.

question: Can I charge my electric scooter here?
answer: Check the filter options. Select '2-Wheeler' or '3-Pin Point' to find chargers compatible with scooters like Ola, Ather, or TVS iQube.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can use the 'Chat Support' feature in the app menu or call the helpline number listed on the physical sticker of the charging machine.

question: What happens if power goes out while charging?
answer: The session will pause. Once power returns, most modern chargers attempt to resume automatically. If not, you may need to restart the session from the app.

question: How do I delete my VoltPath account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. Note that this action is permanent and any remaining wallet balance should be withdrawn first.

question: The charger location on the map is wrong.
answer: We apologize for the inconvenience. Please use the 'Report Issue' button on the station card so our team can update the coordinates immediately.

question: Can I use an extension cord?
answer: No. Never use standard household extension cords for EV charging as they can overheat and melt. Only use manufacturer-approved heavy-duty cables.

question: What is the difference between AC and DC charging?
answer: AC is slower (3-7 hours) and good for homes/offices. DC is fast charging (30-60 mins) used on highways to fill your battery quickly.

question: Do I need an RFID card to charge?
answer: Not necessarily. While some networks offer RFID cards for quick starts, the VoltPath app allows you to start all supported chargers via QR code scanning.

question: Why is there an 'Authorization Hold' on my card?
answer: This is a temporary hold to ensure funds are available. It is not a charge. The hold is released and the actual amount is charged once charging completes.

question: I am not receiving the OTP for login.
answer: Please check your network signal or SMS spam folder. If the issue persists, wait 60 seconds and try the 'Resend via WhatsApp' option.

question: How do I plan a long trip?
answer: Use the 'Trip Planner' tab. Enter your destination and car model. VoltPath will suggest the best charging stops based on your battery range.

question: What if the charger is occupied?
answer: The app shows real-time status: Green for Available, Red for Occupied. If occupied, check the 'Estimated Wait Time' shown on the map pin.

question: Why is the charger making a loud noise?
answer: DC Fast Chargers have powerful cooling fans to keep the electronics cool. A humming or whirring sound is completely normal during operation.

question: Can someone unplug my car while I'm away?
answer: For most modern EVs (CCS2/Type 2), the connector locks into the car port when the car is locked. Strangers cannot unplug it without your car key.

question: Can I charge a Tesla here?
answer: If the station supports CCS2, yes (for compatible models). If the station is Tesla-exclusive (Supercharger), only Tesla vehicles can use it.

question: How do I know if a station has food or washrooms?
answer: Click on the station icon. Under 'Amenities', look for icons representing Restrooms, Cafes, Wi-Fi, or Shopping Centers.

question: Does VoltPath offer reward points?
answer: Yes! You earn 'VoltPoints' for every kWh charged. You can redeem these for discount coupons on future charging sessions.

question: Do I need to bring my own charging cable?
answer: For DC Fast Chargers, the cable is attached to the machine. For AC Slow Chargers, you usually need to bring your own Type 2 cable.

question: Will voltage fluctuation damage my car?
answer: No. EV chargers and your car's onboard charger act as stabilizers. If voltage is unsafe, the charger will simply cut power to protect the vehicle.

question: Can I add multiple vehicles to my profile?
answer: Yes. Go to Profile > My Vehicles > Add New Vehicle. This helps the app suggest compatible chargers for whichever car you are driving.

question: How do I withdraw money from my VoltPath wallet?
answer: Go to Wallet > Settings > Withdraw Balance. The amount will be refunded to the original source within 5-7 working days.

question: Can I charge as a guest without logging in?
answer: Yes, but features like Charging History, Invoices, and Wallet payments will be disabled. We recommend logging in for a smoother experience.

question: Is the estimated range accurate?
answer: Range estimates are based on average driving. Use of AC, high speeds, and uphill terrain will reduce actual range compared to the estimate.

question: The charger screen says 'Network Offline'.
answer: This means the charger lost internet connectivity. Try refreshing the app. If it persists, the charger cannot be started remotely.

question: Will I get notified when charging is done?
answer: Yes, enable Push Notifications in settings. You will receive an alert when your battery reaches 80% and 100%, or if charging stops unexpectedly.

question: How do I report a broken charger?
answer: Select the station on the map, scroll down, and tap 'Report Issue'. You can upload a photo and describe the problem (e.g., 'Screen Broken').

question: Can I save my favorite stations?
answer: Yes. Tap the 'Heart' icon on any station card to add it to your Favorites list for quick access later.

question: How long will it take to charge?
answer: It varies. A 30kW DC charger adds ~100km range in 40 mins. A 7kW AC charger takes 6-8 hours for a full charge.

question: Does heat affect charging speed?
answer: Yes. Extreme heat (above 40°C) can slow down charging as the car's thermal management system works harder to cool the battery.

question: Can I get a GST invoice?
answer: Yes. Ensure your GST number is updated in your Profile. All invoices generated after that will include your GST details.

question: Which charger is best for Tata Nexon EV?
answer: Nexon EV uses the CCS2 standard. Look for any DC Fast Charger rated 25kW or higher for the best experience.

question: How do I share a station location?
answer: Tap the 'Share' icon on the station details card. You can send the Google Maps link directly via WhatsApp or SMS.

question: Is there a virtual queue system?
answer: Not yet. Currently, queuing is physical. Please park behind the car currently charging and wait for your turn.

question: What are the different connector types?
answer: CCS2 (Fast DC), Type 2 (Slow AC), CHAdeMO (Legacy DC), and Bharat DC001 (Old slow DC for commercial cars).

question: Is there a monthly membership plan?
answer: We are working on 'VoltPass', a subscription that will offer lower rates per unit. Stay tuned for updates!

question: Can I change the app language?
answer: Yes. Go to Settings > Language. We currently support English, Hindi, Tamil, and Marathi.

question: How do I update the app?
answer: Visit the Google Play Store or Apple App Store and search for 'VoltPath'. If an update is available, tap 'Update'.

question: Why was I charged an 'Idle Fee'?
answer: An Idle Fee is charged if you leave your car plugged in after charging is complete. This discourages blocking the charger so other users can charge.

question: A petrol/diesel car is parked in the EV charging slot.
answer: This is called 'ICEing'. Please ask the station security or staff to assist in moving the vehicle. You can also report the station status as 'Blocked' in the app.

question: Can I sit inside the car with AC on while charging?
answer: Yes, it is safe. However, using the AC consumes battery power, which may slightly increase the total charging time.

question: Do I have to pay for parking separately?
answer: It depends on the location. Charging costs usually do not include parking fees charged by malls, hotels, or public parking lots. Please check the local signage.

question: Why did my charging speed drop when another car plugged in?
answer: Some dual-gun chargers use 'Load Balancing'. If two cars charge simultaneously, the total power (e.g., 60kW) splits between them (30kW each).

question: I lost my VoltPath RFID card. What should I do?
answer: Go to Profile > RFID Management and tap 'Deactivate' immediately to prevent misuse. You can order a replacement card from the same menu.

question: Can I open a corporate account for my fleet?
answer: Yes! VoltPath Business offers centralized billing and fleet management dashboards. Please contact sales@voltpath.com for details.

question: I want to install a charger on my property.
answer: Great! Use the 'Become a Partner' section in the side menu to submit your location details. Our team will evaluate the site for feasibility.

question: Can I filter chargers by specific brands?
answer: Yes. On the Map screen, tap the 'Filter' button and select your preferred networks (e.g., Tata Power, Zeon, Statiq) to see only their chargers.

question: The charger screen is blank/off.
answer: The charger might be in sleep mode. Try plugging it into your car to wake it up. If it remains off, the unit typically has a power fault.

question: How do I apply a promo code?
answer: On the 'Payment Method' screen before starting a session, tap 'Apply Coupon'. Enter your code to get a discount on the session.

question: Will I get an electric shock if I touch the charger in rain?
answer: No. The casing is grounded and insulated. However, avoid touching the copper pins inside the connector directly with wet hands.

question: Is it safe for children to be around the charger?
answer: While chargers are safe, they are high-voltage industrial equipment. Keep children away from the cables and connectors to prevent tripping or accidental damage.

question: Can I use a charger if I have a pacemaker?
answer: EV chargers emit electromagnetic fields. While generally safe, it is recommended to maintain a distance of at least 6-12 inches from the main unit and cables.

question: Should I clean the connector pins?
answer: No! Never insert anything into the connector pins. If you see debris, use compressed air or report it to the station operator.

question: Can I use a 3-pin socket at a public station?
answer: Some public stations have a 15A socket for emergency slow charging. You must bring your own portable charger (travel adapter) to use these.

question: Is there a referral program?
answer: Yes. Go to 'Invite Friends' in the menu. Share your link, and you both get ₹100 charging credit after their first successful session.

question: How do I enable auto-recharge for my wallet?
answer: In Wallet Settings, toggle 'Auto-Reload'. You can set a threshold (e.g., when balance < ₹100, add ₹500) so you never run out of funds.

question: I didn't receive my invoice via email.
answer: Check your spam folder. You can also manually download past invoices anytime from the 'Charging History' section in the app.

question: The charger location doesn't exist (Ghost Station).
answer: Please report this immediately using the 'Report Issue' > 'Location Incorrect' option. We will verify and delist the station if necessary.

question: Can I use FaceID or Fingerprint to login?
answer: Yes. You can enable Biometric Login in the App Settings for faster and more secure access to your account.

question: Can I use the same account on two phones?
answer: Yes, you can be logged in on multiple devices. Both phones will see the same wallet balance and live session status.

question: Can I transfer my wallet balance to a friend?
answer: No. Wallet balances are non-transferable between accounts. You can only use it for charging your own sessions.

question: Does the app support Dark Mode?
answer: Yes. The app follows your system settings by default. You can manually force Dark or Light mode in the Settings menu.

question: Can I use the map offline?
answer: Basic map viewing might work if cached, but you need an active internet connection to see real-time charger status and start sessions.

question: How do I cancel a reservation?
answer: Go to 'My Bookings', select the upcoming slot, and tap 'Cancel'. Refunds are processed according to the cancellation policy shown at booking.

question: Can I edit my review of a station?
answer: Yes. Go to Charging History, find the session, and tap 'Edit Review'. Your feedback helps other users choose better stations.

question: Why isn't my office charger showing on the map?
answer: Some chargers are marked as 'Private' or 'Restricted Access' and are hidden from the public map. Ask your facility manager for the access link.

question: Does my wallet balance expire?
answer: Cash balance added via UPI/Card never expires. However, promotional credits or VoltPoints may have a validity period of 6-12 months.

question: I think I was overcharged for a session.
answer: Please raise a dispute from the 'Charging History' page. Select the session and tap 'Report Billing Issue'. Our team will audit the logs.

question: The charger cable scratched my car.
answer: Please handle heavy DC cables with care. VoltPath is a discovery platform and is not liable for physical damages caused by station hardware.

question: Are pets allowed at charging stations?
answer: Outdoor stations are generally pet-friendly. However, keep pets inside the vehicle or on a leash for safety around moving traffic.

question: Can I smoke near the charger?
answer: No. Charging stations are strict No Smoking zones. Batteries emit gases that can be flammable in rare failure scenarios.

question: Can I eat while charging?
answer: Yes. Many charging hubs have cafes nearby. Please do not leave trash or food waste around the charging equipment.

question: I want to speak to a manager immediately.
answer: For urgent escalations, please email escalation@voltpath.com with your Ticket ID. Our senior support team will respond within 24 hours.

question: Does this charger support 800V cars?
answer: Check the station details. Chargers rated 150kW+ often support 800V architecture (like Kia EV6, Taycan) for ultra-fast charging.

question: Is there a tyre inflator at the station?
answer: Some premium charging hubs offer air/nitrogen filling. Look for the 'Tyre Service' icon in the station amenities list.

question: Can I update my car software while charging?
answer: It is NOT recommended. Many cars disable charging during a firmware update, or the update might fail if power fluctuates.

question: My battery dropped 5% while parked overnight.
answer: This is 'Phantom Drain', caused by background systems (Sentry mode, connected apps). It is normal and not related to the charging app.

question: Can I charge by towing the car (Regen)?
answer: While technically possible in some EVs, it is dangerous and can overheat the motor/battery. Always use a proper charger.

question: Is this charging station solar powered?
answer: Stations powered by renewable energy are marked with a 'Green Leaf' icon on the map. These offer a zero-emission charging experience.

question: Does the app support V2L (Vehicle to Load)?
answer: V2L is a feature of your car, not the app. You can use your car's V2L adapter to power camping gear or laptops independently.

question: Is the station wheelchair accessible?
answer: Look for the 'Wheelchair Accessible' icon. These stations have wider parking bays and lowered screens/connectors.

question: How do I connect to the station Wi-Fi?
answer: If available, the Wi-Fi name and password will be displayed on the 'Session Active' screen so you can work or stream while charging.

question: I see an error code (e.g., Err 001) on the machine.
answer: Please enter this error code into the 'Chat Support' bot. It will look up the specific technical manual and guide you.

question: The cable is too short to reach my port.
answer: Please park closer or reverse into the spot. Never try to stretch the cable tight, as it may damage your car's charging port.

question: How accurate is the estimated wait time?
answer: It is an estimate based on the current user's battery percentage. Actual wait time may vary if they charge to 100% instead of 80%.

question: Can I claim GST input credit?
answer: Yes. If you registered as a Business Account and provided a GSTIN, your monthly tax invoice will support input credit claims.

question: My car is 400V. Can I use a 750V charger?
answer: Yes. Modern DC chargers automatically adjust the voltage to match your car's battery voltage (e.g., 400V for Nexon, 800V for EV6).

question: Do you track my location when not using the app?
answer: No. We only access your location when the app is open to find nearby chargers. We do not track your driving history.

question: Does cold weather affect charging speed?
answer: Yes. Cold batteries accept charge more slowly to prevent damage. You might see speeds drop by 30-50% until the battery warms up.

question: What is 'Battery Preconditioning'?
answer: It is a feature in some EVs that warms up the battery before you reach a fast charger, ensuring you get maximum charging speed immediately upon plugging in.

question: Can I sleep in my car while charging?
answer: Yes, it is safe. Just ensure you lock the doors from the inside. If using AC/Heater, keep an eye on the battery level so you don't drain it too much.

question: Can I charge while towing a trailer?
answer: Yes, but you may need to unhitch the trailer if the charging spot is not a 'pull-through' type, to avoid blocking the drive lane.

question: Why are extension cords dangerous for EVs?
answer: EVs draw high continuous current. Household extension cords usually cannot handle this load, leading to overheating, melting, or fire hazards.

question: Does VoltPath work on Apple CarPlay / Android Auto?
answer: Yes! You can view nearby chargers and navigate to them directly from your car's dashboard screen using our CarPlay/Android Auto integration.

question: Is there a VoltPath app for smartwatches?
answer: Yes. You can check your active session status (Battery %, Time Remaining) directly on your Apple Watch or Wear OS device.

question: Can I use voice commands to find chargers?
answer: Yes. You can say 'Hey Siri, find a charger on VoltPath' or use Google Assistant shortcuts to locate the nearest station hands-free.

question: How do I switch to Dark Mode?
answer: The app follows your phone's system settings. You can also force Dark Mode in VoltPath Settings > Display > Theme.

question: Is the app accessible for visually impaired users?
answer: Yes, VoltPath is optimized for screen readers like TalkBack (Android) and VoiceOver (iOS) with labeled buttons and high-contrast text.

question: What is 'Peak Time' pricing?
answer: Some stations charge higher rates during busy hours (e.g., 6 PM - 10 PM) to manage grid load. Check the station details for time-based rates.

question: Are there discounts for charging at night?
answer: Yes! Many chargers offer 'Off-Peak' discounts (usually 11 PM - 6 AM). You can filter the map to find stations with these dynamic rates.

question: What is 'AutoCharge'?
answer: AutoCharge allows the session to start automatically when you plug in, without scanning a QR code. You can enable this for compatible cars in the 'My Vehicles' section.

question: Does VoltPath support ISO 15118 Plug & Charge?
answer: We are rolling this out selectively. It requires both a compatible car and a compatible charger to securely authenticate via the cable itself.

question: I saw someone damaging a charger.
answer: Please report it immediately via the 'Report Issue' button. If you feel unsafe, do not confront them; contact local authorities or station security.

question: I left my personal item at the charging station.
answer: Please contact the station operator's customer care number listed on the charger sticker. VoltPath does not manage lost and found items directly.

question: The charger screen is too dirty to read.
answer: Please do not use water to clean it. Wipe it gently with a dry cloth if available, or use the app to start the session without needing the screen.

question: I can't read the screen due to sun glare.
answer: Try shading the screen with your hand. If the QR code is unreadable, you can enter the 6-digit Station ID manually in the app to start charging.

question: Is there a First Aid kit at the station?
answer: Some staffed charging hubs have First Aid kits and AEDs. Check the 'Amenities' section of the station details for the 'Medical Assistance' icon.

question: Where is the fire extinguisher?
answer: By law, all public charging stations must have a fire extinguisher nearby (usually Type ABC or CO2). Look for the red canister near the main electrical panel.

question: Are the charging stations monitored by cameras?
answer: Most premium hubs have 24/7 CCTV surveillance for your safety. Look for the 'CCTV' icon in the station amenities list.

question: Is the station well-lit at night?
answer: We prioritize safety. Stations verified as 'Well Lit' have a 'Lightbulb' icon. We recommend avoiding unlit, isolated stations late at night.

question: Are the washrooms clean?
answer: Washrooms are managed by the site host (e.g., fuel station, mall). We encourage users to rate washroom cleanliness in their session review.

question: How do I access the AC Lounge?
answer: Some lounges require a keypad code, which is displayed in the app once your charging session begins. Others are open to all charging customers.

question: What food options are nearby?
answer: Tap the 'Nearby' tab on the station card to see a list of restaurants and cafes within walking distance, along with their ratings.

question: What is 'Roaming' in EV charging?
answer: Roaming allows you to use the VoltPath app to charge at partner networks (like Zeon or Statiq) without downloading their separate apps.

question: Can I schedule a charge to start later?
answer: Public chargers typically start immediately. However, you can use your car's onboard 'Scheduled Charging' setting to control when it accepts power.

question: Can I set a charging limit (e.g., stop at 80%)?
answer: Yes. Most DC chargers allow you to drag a slider in the app to set a max SoC limit (e.g., 80% or 90%) to stop the session automatically.

question: Can I lower the charging current?
answer: On AC chargers, yes. Your car usually has a setting to limit AC charging current (e.g., 16A to 10A). DC fast charging is controlled automatically by the car.

question: Charging stopped due to 'Voltage Error'.
answer: This happens if the grid voltage is unstable (too high or low). The charger cuts off to protect your car. Try again after a few minutes.

question: Charger says 'Grounding Fault' or 'Earth Error'.
answer: This is a serious safety check. It means the station's earthing is poor. Do NOT attempt to charge here using hacks/bypass adapters. Move to another station.

question: My car says 'Isolation Fault'.
answer: This implies a current leak in the high-voltage system of the car or charger. It prevents charging to avoid shock. Visit your car service center if this persists.

question: Charging failed at 'Handshake' or 'Initializing'.
answer: The car and charger failed to talk. Try unplugging, locking the car, unlocking it, and plugging in again. Ensure the connector is pushed in firmly.

question: Is it safe to charge during a lightning storm?
answer: Public chargers have surge protection (SPD), but it is generally safer to unplug and wait out a severe lightning storm to protect your car's electronics.

question: The charging station is flooded.
answer: Do NOT charge if the water level reaches the cables or the base of the unit. Electricity and standing water are a dangerous combination.

question: Will my car insurance cover charging damage?
answer: Comprehensive insurance usually covers fire or electrical damage during charging, but check your specific policy wording for 'EV Charging' clauses.

question: Does fast charging void my battery warranty?
answer: No. Manufacturers design EVs to handle fast charging. However, frequent charging to 100% via DC may accelerate degradation over many years.

question: What happens to old EV batteries?
answer: They are often repurposed for stationary grid storage (Second Life) or recycled to recover lithium, cobalt, and nickel. VoltPath partners with certified recyclers.

question: How much CO2 did I save?
answer: Check your 'Impact' tab. We calculate CO2 savings by comparing your EV kilometers to a comparable petrol car's emissions.

question: Can I put my company logo on the charger?
answer: Yes! If you host a charger, you can opt for custom branding. Contact our 'VoltPath Business' team for customization options.

question: How do I join the VoltPath Beta program?
answer: Go to Settings > About > Join Beta. You'll get early access to new features like 'Plug & Charge' and 'Smart Route Planning' before everyone else.

question: I found a bug in the app.
answer: Please report it via 'Shake to Report' or in the Help section. We offer small rewards (VoltPoints) for verified bug reports!

question: Do you have an API for developers?
answer: Yes, we offer an Open API for map data and station status. Visit developer.voltpath.com to request an API key.

question: Are you hiring?
answer: We are always looking for electric talent! Check our LinkedIn page or the 'Careers' section on our website for open roles.

question: Is there a community forum?
answer: Yes. Join the 'VoltClub' in the app to discuss EV tips, share route advice, and meet other EV owners in your city.

question: How do I earn the 'Super Charger' badge?
answer: Badges are awarded for milestones like '1000 Green KMs', 'First Interstate Trip', or 'Top Reviewer'. Check your Profile to see your collection.

question: Is there a limit to referral rewards?
answer: You can refer up to 50 friends per year. After that, you still help the planet, but won't receive additional monetary credits.

question: Can I use two coupons at once?
answer: No. Only one promo code can be applied per charging session. The app will automatically select the best available offer for you.

question: I raised a chargeback with my bank.
answer: Raising a chargeback freezes your VoltPath account. Please contact support to resolve billing issues directly to avoid account suspension.

question: My UPI payment failed repeatedly.
answer: This is often due to bank server downtime. Please try a different payment mode like Credit Card or Net Banking, or try again in 15 minutes.

question: I was charged twice for the same session.
answer: This is a rare gateway error. The duplicate transaction is usually auto-reversed by your bank within 24-48 hours. If not, send us the Transaction IDs.

question: My payment status is 'Pending'.
answer: This means the bank hasn't confirmed success or failure yet. Wait for 10 minutes. If it fails, money will be refunded automatically.

question: The app is stuck on 'Initializing Charging'.
answer: If it spins for more than 60 seconds, the communication timed out. Unplug, force-close the app, and try starting a new session.

question: The session is stuck on 'Finishing'.
answer: Don't worry, charging has likely stopped physically. You can safely unplug if the gun is unlocked. The app status will update shortly.

question: Is there a penalty for pressing the Emergency Button?
answer: Misusing the Emergency Stop for non-emergencies (like a regular stop) may incur a technician reset fee, as it requires manual intervention to fix the charger.

question: Can I tap my phone (NFC) to start charging?
answer: Some newer chargers support NFC tap. If you see the NFC symbol, you can tap your phone (with VoltPath wallet enabled) to authenticate.

question: Where do I tap my RFID card?
answer: Look for the WiFi-like symbol on the charger face. It is usually located below the screen or near the connector holster.

question: What do the LED colors mean?
answer: Typically: Green = Available, Blue = Charging, Red = Fault/Error, Flashing = Authenticating. Check the sticker on the charger for specific codes.

question: Any specific tips for MG ZS EV?
answer: The ZS EV charge port is behind the front grille logo. Press the logo to open. It supports max 75kW DC charging.

question: Where is the port on Hyundai Kona/Ioniq 5?
answer: Kona: Front bumper (driver side). Ioniq 5: Rear right side (motorized flap). Ioniq 5 supports ultra-fast 800V charging.

question: Charging tips for BYD Atto 3?
answer: BYD uses LFP batteries which love being charged to 100%. The charging port is on the front right wing. It handles DC charging up to 80kW.

question: Can Tata Tiago/Tigor EV use fast charging?
answer: Yes, they use CCS2. However, their max DC charging speed is capped around 25kW, so using a 150kW charger won't make it faster.

question: Charging info for Mahindra XUV400?
answer: The port is on the front left fender. Ensure the car is in 'P' (Park) and unlocked to initiate the handshake successfully.

question: Citroen eC3 charging speed issues?
answer: The eC3 has an air-cooled battery. In very hot weather or after long drives, DC charging speed may drop significantly to protect the battery.

question: Volvo XC40 Recharge charging tips?
answer: Volvo recommends setting the max charge limit to 90% for daily use. The port is on the rear left. It supports up to 150kW DC.

question: Does BMW require a special adapter?
answer: No, BMW EVs in India use standard CCS2. The i4 supports up to 205kW DC charging. The port is typically on the rear right.

question: Mercedes EQ series charging features?
answer: Mercedes EQ models often support 'Plug & Charge' on compatible networks. The EQS supports 200kW DC charging for very fast stops.

question: Does Audi e-tron have two ports?
answer: Yes, some e-tron models have ports on both sides! The driver side usually has DC+AC, while the passenger side is AC only.

question: Can I charge my Ola S1 Pro here?
answer: Only at stations marked 'Ola Hypercharger' or standard 15A AC sockets (using your portable cable). You cannot use CCS2 DC guns for scooters.

question: Is this an Ather Grid point?
answer: Ather uses a proprietary connector. Filter the map for 'Ather Grid' to find compatible fast chargers for your 450X/Rizta.

question: Is there a security guard on site?
answer: Look for the 'Security Guard' icon. These stations have personnel present, which is recommended if you are charging alone at night.

question: Is there a play area for kids?
answer: Some highway charging hubs offer children's play areas. Check the 'Amenities' list for the 'Playground' icon.

question: Where can I walk my dog while charging?
answer: Many highway stations have designated pet relief areas. Please remember to clean up after your pet to keep the station clean.

question: Is there shopping nearby?
answer: Yes, stations located at Malls or Shopping Centers are marked with a 'Shopping Bag' icon. Perfect for charging while you shop!

question: Can I watch a movie while charging?
answer: If the charger is at a Cinema complex, yes! A typical movie (2-3 hours) is perfect for a full AC Slow Charge.

question: Can I book a hotel room from the app?
answer: Not directly, but we show 'EV Friendly Hotels' on the map. These hotels offer overnight charging so you wake up with 100% battery.

question: Are there chargers at hospitals?
answer: Yes, many hospitals are installing chargers. Filter by 'Public Facility' to find them. Useful for doctors or visitors.

question: Can I leave my car charging at the airport?
answer: Only in designated 'Long Term EV Parking' zones. Do not leave it at a Fast Charger (DC) as idle fees will be huge.

question: Can I charge at my office?
answer: If your office has partnered with VoltPath, you will see 'Workplace' chargers in the app. You may need an employee code to access them.

question: Can I install a shared charger in my apartment?
answer: Yes! VoltPath offers 'Community Charger' solutions for housing societies. Contact us to set up a shared billing system for residents.

question: I have land. Can I host a charging station?
answer: Yes! You can earn rent or revenue share. Visit the 'Partner With Us' page to submit your property details for evaluation.

question: Is there a franchise model?
answer: Yes, VoltPath offers a FOCO (Franchise Owned Company Operated) model. You invest in the hardware, and we manage the operations.

question: Can I advertise on the charger screens?
answer: Yes, the large screens on DC chargers support digital OOH advertising. Contact our media team for ad rates and slots.

question: What is the ROI for a charging station?
answer: ROI depends on utilization. A busy highway location can break even in 2-3 years. Slow urban chargers take longer but cost less to install.

question: Do I need a license to install a public charger?
answer: In India, EV charging is a de-licensed activity. You do not need a special license to sell power for EVs, but you need a sanctioned electrical load.

question: Are there subsidies for installing chargers?
answer: State EV policies vary. Some states offer a capital subsidy (up to 25%) on equipment for the first few hundred chargers. Check your local state policy.

question: How much power load do I need?
answer: For a DC Fast Charger (60kW), you typically need a 70kW+ connection. For a slow AC charger, a standard 7kW single-phase connection works.

question: Do I need a separate transformer?
answer: For high-power stations (above 100kW total load), a dedicated distribution transformer (DT) is usually required by the DISCOM.

question: Can I use VoltPath software on my own charger?
answer: Yes! We offer our CMS (Charger Management System) as a SaaS product. You can onboard your existing hardware onto the VoltPath network.

question: Can I get a white-label app for my brand?
answer: Yes, we build custom charging apps for Fleet Operators and Real Estate developers powered by the VoltPath backend.

question: Is my data safe with VoltPath?
answer: Absolutely. We comply with global data privacy standards. Your location and payment data are encrypted and never sold to third parties.

question: How do I download my personal data?
answer: Go to Settings > Privacy > Request Data. We will email you a zip file containing your session history and account details within 48 hours.

question: Can I pay with an international credit card?
answer: Yes, we accept Visa/Mastercard from anywhere. However, all transactions are processed in INR (Indian Rupees).

question: When will you add Telugu/Kannada support?
answer: We are working on it! We plan to support all major regional Indian languages by the end of this year.

question: Is there a Color Blind mode?
answer: Yes. Enable 'High Contrast Mode' in settings. It changes the Red/Green status indicators to Blue/Orange patterns for better visibility.

question: Can I disable vibration feedback?
answer: Yes. Go to Settings > Sound & Haptics and toggle off 'Vibration on Touch'.

question: Does VoltPath have a home screen widget?
answer: Yes! Add our widget to your home screen to see the nearest charger and your wallet balance without opening the app.

question: Can I download offline maps?
answer: Currently, we rely on Google Maps/Mapbox which support offline areas. We recommend downloading your region in Google Maps for backup.

question: Do you offer Roadside Assistance (RSA)?
answer: We partner with RSA providers. If you run out of charge, use the 'SOS' button in the app to request a tow truck to the nearest charger.

question: I have an idea for a new feature!
answer: We love user feedback! Please submit your ideas via the 'Feature Request' board in the Help section. Users vote on the best ideas!
